extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: retro cash register, approx. 42 x 46 x 46 cm
extras.notes: mint housing with chrome edges, sloped key bank with 24 round blank keys (cream, butter, pink) with chrome rims and a long chrome total key, chrome side crank with a cream grip, flip display showing three stars instead of numbers under an arched chrome crest; cream cash drawer 'cash-register_drawer' is a separate object (origin at the middle of the drawer front, slides out along -Y) with compartments and plain gold coins; no text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
